study type: Experimental animal study (developmental and reproductive toxicity assessment)
exposure: KGC-HJ3 (Korean Red Ginseng with Angelica gigas and deer antlers) at 0 mg/kg
cohort: Sprague-Dawley rats (22 animals per sex per group for fertility and early embryonic development, and 22 mating-proven females per group for maternal and embryo-fetal development).
finding: KGC-HJ3 did not show any toxicological potential on developmental and reproductive functions in Sprague-Dawley rats at doses up to 2000 mg/kg/day.
